triggers.name: new_updated_record
triggers.title: New/updated record
triggers.help: The new updated trigger has a set maximum look back limit of 1 hour from when the trigger starts polling.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the RowShare object for trigger

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own RowShare action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your RowShare connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: assign_row
actions.title: Assign row
actions.description: Assign row to user in RowShare

input.name: Id
input.label: ID
input.hint: You get the row ID either via the New/Updated Row trigger or via an external reference.

input.name: Version
input.label: Version
input.hint: To avoid concurrency update issues, you may provide the actual version of the row to be updated manually. If not provided, Workato retrieves the current version automatically.

actions.name: create_record
actions.title: Create record
actions.help: Creates a record, e.g. Row in RowShare

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any RowShare object, e.g. Row

actions.name: delete_record
actions.title: Delete record
actions.help: Deletes a record, e.g. Row in RowShare

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any RowShare object, e.g. Row

actions.name: get_record
actions.title: Get record details by ID
actions.description: Get record by ID in RowShare
actions.help: Retrieve the details of a record, e.g. Row via its ID

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any RowShare object, e.g. Row

actions.help: The Search records action returns results that matches your search criteria.

input.name: object

input.hint: Select any RowShare object, e.g. Row
